notes:
Moagram 13.2.2 preview 4

- Fixes downloads that hang near the end. With Download Speed Boost, a single chunk stuck on a slow connection could hold up a whole file for 25 seconds or more. Moagram now re-requests that chunk on another connection and uses whichever copy arrives first.
- Removes the Ghost Mode quick-toggle icon from the chat list header. Ghost Mode is still available in Settings -> Moagram Settings -> Ghost Mode.

Android 6.0 or later. Install over your existing Moagram app to keep accounts and settings.
critical_message: This update fixes downloads that hang near the end and removes the Ghost Mode icon from the chat list header. Please install it.
